items.name: setup
items.title: Beamline source base
items.description: Editable runtime, tokens, foundation CSS and helpers in your repository; no Beamline packages.

items.name: look-prism
items.title: Prism look
items.description: Editable Prism look and local font assets (geist, geist-mono, instrument-serif).

items.name: look-metal
items.title: Metal look
items.description: Editable Metal look and local font assets (archivo, geist, geist-mono, inter).

items.name: notification-preferences
items.title: Notification preferences
items.description: What reaches a person and where: events grouped by area down the side, channels (email, push, Slack, in-app) across the top, a switch per pair that saves on its own and steps back if refused, a column switch for a whole channel, channels that still need connecting, alerts that cannot be turned off, a digest, quiet hours and a pause for everything. In a narrow room each event carries its channels as a row of toggles.

items.name: plan-comparison
items.title: Plan comparison
items.description: Plans side by side against every feature: prices that roll between monthly and yearly, the current and recommended plan marked, a header that stays in view while the features scroll, differences only, and included, not included and not specified told apart.

items.name: settings
items.title: Settings
items.description: Profile and workspace settings with one draft and a real save handler, on grouped panels: photo upload, time zone with the local time, appearance cards, notifications by channel, workspace security, members, plan and usage, API keys and a hold-to-confirm danger zone. Personal mode omits workspace data; optional profile fields share validation, persistence, error recovery and focus return.

items.name: sign-in
items.title: Sign in
items.description: The sign-in card: email and password, a one-time code or a magic link, passkeys and single sign-on, with validation, progress, errors and a signed-in state; every step runs on your handlers.

items.name: signup-form
items.title: Sign up form
items.description: The account creation card: single sign-on, name, work email and a password with strength and Caps Lock hints, terms consent, inline validation, your request's progress and errors, an emailed-code check and a finished state.

items.name: team-members
items.title: Team & members
items.description: The people page of a workspace: seats used against the plan, members and pending invitations in one list with search and a role filter, role changes that apply at once and step back if your API refuses, invitations by pasted email list, and removal with Undo that only reaches your API once the Undo window closes.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Topics that open in place, one at a time or several: FAQs and settings sections; each header is a button (with an optional fact at its end), and the panel's height follows its content and can be reversed mid-way.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message that stays until it is dealt with: what happened, what to do, an action; danger and warning are announced; dismissing folds its height away.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A blocking confirmation that must be answered: the scrim does not dismiss it, focus starts on the safe choice, and an async action keeps it open until the work finishes.

items.name: allocation-editor
items.title: Allocation editor
items.description: Parts of a fixed whole edited as transfers: an ordered strip whose boundaries drag or step between neighbours and a roster of exact amounts where typing names the part that gives or takes; locks, limits and your rules refuse with words, nothing is redistributed out of sight, and Save waits for your handler.

items.name: announcement-bar
items.title: Announcement bar
items.description: A banner across the top for news and offers: messages take turns, a countdown ticks, and dismissing folds it away and can remember it.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect ratio
items.description: Holds media, video and embeds at a fixed width-to-height ratio while the layout resizes.

items.name: availability-rule-editor
items.title: Availability rule editor
items.description: When someone (or something) can be booked: hours for each day of the week, one or more ranges a day, a day turned off, a day's hours copied to the others in one step, the time zone they are in, and exceptions for particular dates (a holiday off, a Saturday on). A week strip draws the hours at a glance, a sentence says them back, and overlapping or reversed ranges are said in words where they are.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person or account in a small space: a photo, or initials on the hue their name always gets; presence dot; circle for people, square for companies.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar group
items.description: A team in a small space: overlapping faces that name themselves on hover or focus, and “+N” naming the rest.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short status, category or count label: six tones, an icon or a status dot, two sizes.

items.name: bezel
items.title: Bezel
items.description: A double-bezel frame: an outer shell with a hairline, a small gap, and an inset panel with its own edge, so a preview, chart or media reads as set into the surface.

items.name: bottom-sheet
items.title: Bottom sheet
items.description: A phone panel that rests at a peek and follows the finger to full height; a flick down closes it, and the handle works from the keyboard.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where a page sits and the way back up; it shows as many levels as its room holds and folds the ones nearest the top into a menu.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The action control: five weights and a brand fill, a buy/sell tone, sm/md/lg and a 44 px touch size, icon-only, a loading state that keeps its size and focus, and a label that changes in place.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Month grids for picking a day or a range: a real grid with arrows by day and week, Page keys by month, closed days, today's dot, and a range span that follows the pointer.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A record or a small group of related content and actions: optional media, avatar, title, status, action, meta, free content and a Details toggle; plain or double-bezel frame.

items.name: card-field
items.title: Card field
items.description: A payment card in one field: the number groups as it is typed and names its network, the expiry and security code follow on their own as each part completes, the number is checked (length and checksum) and the expiry must be in the future; when it is complete and you move on, the number folds to its last four digits.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A row of slides that snap into place: swipe on touch, drag or the arrows with a mouse, ← → when focused, or the dots; optional autoplay that pauses and has a pause button.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A yes/no choice with an optional label and help, including the mixed state for select-all; the check draws itself in.

items.name: chip-group
items.title: Chip group
items.description: Quick filters as chips: a chosen chip fills and grows a check, counts show what each would return, and extra chips fold behind “+N”.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Code to read and copy: highlighted in the system's colours, numbered, marked lines, long files folded behind “Show all”.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: One region that opens and closes in place from its trigger, its height animating to the content.

items.name: color-palette
items.title: Color Palette
items.description: A wheel of preset colours to pick from: twelve hues around the ring, their tints inward, white at the middle; the chosen swatch lifts and carries a check.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Colour picker
items.description: A swatch that opens a picker: saturation-brightness plane, hue strip, HEX/RGB/HSL/OKLCH value to type or copy, the screen eyedropper where available, saved colours and the contrast on its background.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: One value from a long list found by typing (time zones, countries, customers): ranked matches with the match emphasised, keywords, optional group headings, clearable; the field keeps focus, and below 640 px the list opens as a bottom sheet with its own search; with onCreate, a search nothing matches exactly offers Create “…” as the last row, and the new choice is chosen and kept, a refused create said with the search kept.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command menu
items.description: Search-first list of every action: ranked matching, groups, keycap shortcuts and nested pages; inline as CommandPalette or in a ⌘K dialog as CommandMenu.

items.name: comment-thread
items.title: Comment thread
items.description: A discussion attached to something: replies, reactions, @mentions, editing and deleting your own, resolve that folds the thread.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: Actions for an object on right-click, long-press, Shift+F10 or the menu key, opened at the pointer, with the same rows as the dropdown menu.

items.name: cookie-consent
items.title: Cookie consent
items.description: Asks once which cookies a visitor allows, with Reject all and Accept all given equal weight; Customise grows the notice in place into each category with its switch, purpose and the cookies behind it; the choice is remembered (and asked again when your policy changes), and a browser's Global Privacy Control keeps marketing off.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: Copies a value and confirms in place: the icon becomes a check and the label says Copied; a refused copy says so instead of pretending.

items.name: credit
items.title: Credit
items.description: "Designed with Beamline" for a site's footer: the Beamline mark and a quiet line, or a small badge. With your partner code, each new customer's first purchase through it earns you 30% in cash.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: One date in a form: a field that opens the month grid under it with focus inside, picks and closes; Today and Clear below, optional clear button.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date range picker
items.description: A reporting range: presets on one side and two months on the other (one on a phone); the trigger names the preset in use, and the footer counts the days; a range can also be typed in words ("last 2 weeks", "Q3", "Mar 3 – Apr 10").

items.name: description-list
items.title: Description list
items.description: The details of one record as label and value pairs: beside each other or stacked, in as many columns as the room holds; a copy button arrives on the row you point at, long values fold behind Show more, a value that changes lights once, and a value never recorded is hatched, never blank or zero.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A focused task over the page (create, invite, rename) with a title, body and footer; focus moves in, is trapped and returns on close.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: Sets left-to-right or right-to-left for everything inside: text and logical spacing flip, and Radix parts read the direction for keys and placement.

items.name: document-viewer
items.title: Document viewer
items.description: A PDF or a paged document read and marked up in place: page thumbnails beside it, zoom to the width, the page or a percentage, pages by keyboard, a search that marks every hit and steps through them, and annotations (highlight text or mark an area, attach a comment) listed beside the pages, each jumping to its place; pages not drawn yet are hatched, and loading, empty, failed and password-locked documents each say so. pdf.js loads only when a PDF is opened.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A list of actions behind a trigger, with shortcuts, check items, headings and submenus; one highlight glides under the pointer and jumps with the keyboard.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: What a place will hold and the first step to fill it, instead of a blank; a compact size for panels and filtered tables.

items.name: expandable-card
items.title: Expandable card
items.description: A dense card that grows in place when asked: the frame resizes and the clamped preview opens into the full text.

items.name: file-diff
items.title: File diff
items.description: A change to one file as a unified diff: line numbers, tinted lines, only the changed words marked, long unchanged stretches folded; give rows or just before and after.

items.name: file-dropzone
items.title: File drop zone
items.description: A generous target for files: drop or choose, each checked against type, size and count with the reason when turned away; uploads show progress and can be cancelled or retried.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Validation wiring for react-hook-form (and zod) on the system's own fields: each field already links its label, help and error, so FormField hands over the value and the message.

items.name: glow
items.title: Glow
items.description: Ambient light around one element that says something is happening: an aurora under a working composer, or a ring of light round a live card.

items.name: hold-to-confirm
items.title: Hold to confirm
items.description: Confirms a costly action by holding instead of clicking: a fill sweeps across while held and drains if let go early; pointer, touch, Space and Enter all hold.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover card
items.description: A preview of a person, link or record on hover or keyboard focus, without leaving the page; HoverCardProfile is the standard person preview.

items.name: image-compare
items.title: Image compare
items.description: Two images in one frame with a divider: drag anywhere, or arrow keys on the handle; horizontal or vertical, with captions.

items.name: image-cropper
items.title: Image cropper
items.description: Frame a picture before it is saved: a fixed window (square, round for avatars, wide for covers, or free with handles) over the picture, which you drag, zoom with the slider, wheel or a pinch, and turn a quarter at a time; it always covers the window, thirds lines show while you move it, and the arrow keys, + and − and R do the same from the keyboard. cropImage turns the result into a file.

items.name: inbox-list
items.title: Inbox list
items.description: Conversations waiting for a person, triaged in place: sender, subject and the first words, time, unread weight, star, labels and attachments, grouped by day; tick several for Archive, Mark read and Delete in a bar that grows over the header, or act on one from its row (hover, keyboard or a swipe on touch). Archived rows close up with Undo in their place.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline edit
items.description: Text, a number or an amount of money that becomes a field in the same place: Enter (or ⌘Enter when multiline) saves, Escape cancels, leaving saves; saving shows progress and a refusal keeps the edit with the reason. InlineNumber reads and writes in the reader's locale (money, units), checks min, max and step, and saves a number; density="cell" fits either in a table cell.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field with its label, help and error wired for assistive tech, three sizes and adornments. With complete or emailDomains it offers whole values under the field (an email's name with each known domain), taken with the arrows and Enter, never replacing what was typed by itself.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: The generic list row: media, title, description, meta and trailing actions; becomes a link or button when interactive.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard keys as keycaps, for combinations and sequences (G then A); `mod` resolves to ⌘ or Ctrl per platform, symbols are spoken as words.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The text label tied to a form control, with a required marker that screen readers announce.

items.name: lightbox
items.title: Lightbox
items.description: A full-screen image viewer: a thumbnail grows into it and shrinks back, arrows and ←/→ step through the set, Esc or a downward drag closes it.

items.name: live-cursors
items.title: Live cursors
items.description: Who else is working on this, and where: over any shared surface, each person's pointer in the colour their name always gets, with a name flag, gliding between the positions your realtime service sends; their selections outlined in the same colour, a short message beside the pointer when they type one (press / for your own), quieter when they go idle and fading when they leave. Positions are fractions of the surface, so every screen size agrees.

items.name: logo-carousel
items.title: Logo Carousel
items.description: A wall of logos shown a few at a time: every few seconds the slots turn left to right, each logo leaving upward as the next rises in.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A labelled point in a stream: a status event with an icon between messages, or a label such as "Today" between two hairlines.

items.name: mention-input
items.title: Mention input
items.description: A composer where @people and #channels become single tokens with suggestions at the caret; the value keeps the text and where each mention sits.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menu bar
items.description: A desktop-style File / Edit / View bar for editor-like apps; each menu takes the same rows as the dropdown menu, and pointing moves between open menus.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi-select
items.description: Several values from a known list as removable chips in the field; the list has a search field (for long lists), checkable rows and a count with Clear. With sortable, the chips keep the chosen order and move by drag or Alt+← / Alt+→ from a chip's ×, the move announced.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: A site or docs header whose sections open into one panel that resizes and slides between them; NavigationMenuCard is the standard link row.

items.name: notification-center
items.title: Notification centre
items.description: Updates that wait to be read: a bell with the unread count opens All / Unread, new and earlier groups, and per item mark read or dismiss.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number field
items.description: A bounded number with − and +: arrows and Page keys step, typing is read in the locale and clamped on leaving, limits can be explained, and the label can scrub.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP input
items.description: A verification code in separate boxes backed by one real field, so paste, SMS autofill and Backspace work; optional groups like 123–456.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Moves through pages of a known length: first, last and the current page's neighbours, with an optional “41–60 of 468”. It answers to its own room: narrow, “Page 6 of 24”; wide, one more neighbour on each side.

items.name: password-field
items.title: Password field
items.description: A password field with a reveal control, and a strength meter when a password is being created.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone input
items.description: A phone number with its country: searchable picker with country and dialling codes, “+44…” switches the country, the number groups as typed, and the value is E.164.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small surface anchored to a trigger for a short form, a filter or an explanation; focus moves in and returns on close.

items.name: product-tour
items.title: Product tour
items.description: A short guided tour over the real interface: a spotlight that glides from one element to the next while the rest of the screen dims, and a card beside each element that says what it does, with its step and progress, Back, Next and Skip; focus moves into the card and comes back where it was, Escape ends the tour, arrows step through it, and a quieter beacon variant marks one new thing without dimming anything.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: How much of a known task is done, or a moving bar when the length is unknown, with an optional label and value.

items.name: qr-code
items.title: QR Code
items.description: A scannable code set as gradient dots with rounded finder rings and an optional centre mark; a new value ripples out from the centre.

items.name: radio-cards
items.title: Radio cards
items.description: One choice among rich options as cards with optional media, icon, detail and a figure; one selection ring follows the stable choice.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: One choice from a short visible set, each option with an optional description, vertical or in a row.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: A score on a small scale: stars that fill as you point (halves too) and light one after another when chosen, with the word for the score beside them; read-only it shows an average to the tenth with its count, and nothing rated yet is hatched; or a 0–10 scale with its two ends named for likelihood questions.

items.name: reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: The agent's trace, fed by your stream: a shimmering label and the seconds so far while it works, then "Thought for N seconds"; steps that check off, prose thoughts, search sources or tool calls, open while running and folded when done.

items.name: recurrence-editor
items.title: Recurrence editor
items.description: How something repeats, set in plain controls and said back in a sentence: every N days, weeks, months or years; which weekdays; in a month, on a date or on the second Tuesday (or the last Friday); ending never, on a date or after a number of times. The next dates are listed so the rule can be checked against a calendar, months without the chosen date are said, and the rule comes out as a value and an iCalendar RRULE.

items.name: resizable-panels
items.title: Resizable panels
items.description: Panes that trade space across draggable dividers; each divider is a focusable separator with arrow keys, limits, folding for collapsible panes and double-click to restore.

items.name: rich-text-editor
items.title: Rich text editor
items.description: A Notion-grade writing surface: slash menu for every block, a formatting toolbar on selection, drag-to-move blocks, nesting, markdown shortcuts, paste from the web or as markdown; outputs HTML, Markdown and JSON.

items.name: run-trace
items.title: Run trace
items.description: One agent run as a waterfall: every step (model calls, tools, retrieval, checks, sub-agents) nested under the step that started it, each a bar on a shared time axis, with retries as separate attempts on the same bar, tokens and cost per step and for the run; while it runs the bars grow live, and choosing a step shows its timing, attempts, input and output beside the trace.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: A native scroll region with thin overlay thumbs and edge fades that show only where more content waits; thumbs can be dragged or clicked.

items.name: scrubber
items.title: Scrubber
items.description: A budget, a timeout or a position on a scale where the neighbourhood matters: the readout says how far under or over the named limit the value is, the ticks can be real measurements ("87% of requests at or under 90 ms"), hover shows where a press lands, a lens opens around the knob while it is held or focused (the knob never moves under it), and a release decides at once while the knob settles with the look's physics.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search field
items.description: The search entry point: magnifier, clear button, Escape to clear, a shortcut hint and an optional live border beam.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Two to five views or ranges of the same content (1D / 1W / 1M, List / Board): a radio group whose raised thumb slides to the choice.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: One choice from a short known list, in the same frame as every text field: label, help, error, option groups and details.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline between groups, horizontal or vertical; hidden from screen readers unless it carries meaning.

items.name: share-dialog
items.title: Share dialog
items.description: Share a document, board or project: invite people by name or email with the access they get, change or remove anyone's access in place, and set who the link opens for, with Copy link; inviting turns the dialog into the invitation (role, notify, a note) and back.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge with the page still visible behind it: header and footer stay put while the body scrolls.

items.name: shortcut-recorder
items.title: Shortcut recorder
items.description: Lets people set their own shortcut: press the keys, see them as keycaps; a clash or a browser-kept shortcut asks first. ShortcutCheatsheet lists every shortcut, searchable.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: The app's main navigation: sections, items with counts and one level of sub-pages, an icon rail with tooltips (⌘B, the trigger or the edge), and a sheet on phones.

items.name: signature-pad
items.title: Signature pad
items.description: A pad for a drawn signature whose ink follows a stylus's pressure (and thins with speed under a mouse or finger); undo, replay, PNG or SVG export, and typing instead for keyboards and screen readers.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Holds the shape of content while it loads, then crossfades into it, so nothing jumps.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A value or range on a known scale: the thumb grows under the finger and shows its value while dragged or focused; marks, end icons and a value readout.

items.name: slot-text
items.title: Slot text
items.description: Text and numbers that roll into their new value on reels, digit by digit from the right; other characters fade. Read as plain text by assistive tech.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A ring that spins while work runs and closes into a drawn check or cross when it ends.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split button
items.description: One obvious action joined to a menu of close alternatives; both halves are real buttons and the menu uses the shared menu rows.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Where someone is in a multi-step flow: done steps carry a check, the current one a ring, and the line between marks fills as steps complete.

items.name: swipe-actions
items.title: Swipe actions
items.description: Row actions behind a swipe on touch screens and a two-finger swipe on a trackpad, and at the row's end for pointer and keyboard (a ⋯ menu in a narrow row, icon buttons in a wide one); a full swipe runs the edge action.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A setting that applies at once: a thumb that slides on a spring and stretches under the finger, with an optional label before or after.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A native HTML table for small datasets, composed with children or driven by records; shared server paging, sorting, filters, search, stable-ID selection and retry.

items.name: table-of-contents
items.title: Table of contents
items.description: The sections of a long page beside it, with the one being read marked as you scroll: the marker travels down the rail between sections, the rail fills with how far you have read, a click glides to the section and hands it focus; the quiet variant is a column of ticks that opens into names when pointed at, and a narrow room folds it into one “On this page” line.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between panels of one object; one indicator slides to the active tab, counts sit beside labels, and the tabs a row has no room for fold into More.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag input
items.description: Short free-form values as tags: Enter, comma or Tab adds, a pasted list adds them all, Backspace twice removes the last; duplicates and invalid values are said, not dropped silently.

items.name: text-morph
items.title: Text morph
items.description: A short label that becomes its next state letter by letter: shared letters glide into place, new ones arrive, old ones leave.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text reveal
items.description: A headline whose words rise into place once, the first time it scrolls into view; never repeats.

items.name: text-shimmer
items.title: Text shimmer
items.description: Ongoing work said in words (“Thinking…”) with a calm band of light passing across them; stops when inactive.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line plain text that grows with what is typed up to a limit, with an optional character count.

items.name: theme-switch
items.title: Theme switch
items.description: The light/dark control: the page changes in one of four transitions starting from the button (reveal, eclipse, split, rise), and the icon turns between sun and moon.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time picker
items.description: A time of day as hour and minute segments, typed or stepped, 12- or 24-hour; the clock opens a list of times at the step.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: What happened, newest first and grouped by day: people with avatars, systems with toned icons, relative times with the exact time on hover, details in place.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Short results of an action stacked at an edge: point at the stack to fan it out and pause the timers; undo or retry in place; Alt+T, Escape and a swipe for the keyboard and touch.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: Pressable toggles where one or several can be on: alignment, bold and italic, view options; bare for toolbars or framed.

items.name: tool-call
items.title: Tool call
items.description: One tool call in an agent's run: status, what it did and a short result on one quiet row that opens to the exact input and output; stops for permission when needed, with progress and the reason if allowing fails.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short supporting text for a control: opens after a moment on hover and at once on keyboard focus; inside a toolbar group the next one opens instantly.

items.name: tree-select
items.title: Tree select
items.description: A field that picks from a tree: departments and teams, categories and subcategories, folders, regions and cities; the list opens as an indented tree whose branches fold, search keeps the path to every match and opens it, one value shows its whole path in the field, and several values tick whole branches at once (a branch half chosen shows a dash) and fold a fully chosen branch into one chip.

items.name: tree-view
items.title: Tree view
items.description: Nested folders and records with the full tree keyboard model (arrows, Home/End, *, type to jump), depth guides, counts and animated opening.

items.name: ui-root
items.title: UI root
items.description: Makes a region of any app a Beamline root: theme, brand and direction for everything inside, and a matching layer at page level where its menus, dialogs and tooltips open.

items.name: usage-meter
items.title: Usage meter
items.description: An allowance and what fills it: one bar split by source, the room left, a warning near the limit and the overflow in its own red well past a notch at the limit.

items.name: user-menu
items.title: User menu
items.description: The account menu behind the avatar: who is signed in, status, theme, account pages and sign out with progress; a bottom sheet on phones.

items.name: video
items.title: Video player
items.description: A video player on the native <video> element: title bar with an external link and close, centre play with ±10 s, scrub, time, volume, speed, captions drawn in the system's type, picture-in-picture and fullscreen; full keyboard control, and loading, buffering, ended and error states.

items.name: free
items.title: Beamline free components
items.description: All 126 free Beamline components, MIT: editable source in src/ui/beamline.
